title: Coco Skibidi
description: Coco Skibidi is a game of rhythm, hand-eye coordination and hair-pulling action! With the fate of two Skibidi Toilet at your finger tips, its up to you to keep them from getting coconuts! Key Features: - Great Gameplay. - Cute Graphic. - Simple Gameplay. - One click/touch to play.
instructions: Mouse click or tap to play
